_comment: MAXIMUM-REALISM G5S6R4, 3600 s. The simplified reciprocal ISL time-transfer mode and the future physical four-timestamp mode both remain disabled in this scenario.
_realism: R-1..R-10: realistic caesium clock, IGS-RTS tower product sigma, C/N0 code weighting, multipath/hardware/PCV/survey/DCB truth systematics, relativistic clock, honest measurement floors, luni-solar and SRP in both truth and estimator force families, EOP/solid-Earth tide, inter-antenna carrier bias.
_atmosphere: The two master enables that are OFF in masterConfig. cfg.atmosphere.realistic is already true by default, so switching these on gives the Niell/Saastamoinen troposphere and the diurnal + topside + Klobuchar ionosphere with scintillation -- not the synthetic placeholder.
_isl: Full one-way crosslink stack. carrier.sigma_m stays at the defensible 0.20 m default; slipDetection.threshold_m NaN auto-derives as 5*sqrt(2)*sigma so it can never desynchronise from R.

measurements._twstftNote: ISL time transfer is disabled. Ground-to-space first-order reciprocal time transfer remains enabled in this stress scenario.

_lambda: External TU Delft LAMBDA 4.0. applyFix is TRUE because the ISL AR path is a no-op unless it is: with applyFix=false the resolver returns before ever being called, so LAMBDA would appear enabled while doing nothing. The safety is the resolver's OWN bootstrapped success-rate gate (0.999) plus the ratio test -- it refuses any fix it cannot justify, and partial fixes are rejected outright rather than fabricating integers. Expect refusal here: ISL carrier sigma 0.20 m is ~1.05 cycles at L1, so the success rate lands far below the gate and the run should report 'rejected' with the measured rate. That refusal IS the result. Ground AR acts on the ATTITUDE baselines (Route A), where between-antenna differencing cancels both clocks and dN is genuinely integer.
_crosslinkLayer: Relative layer: two-way ISL with the physics-derived link budget (sigma from free-space path loss, anchored at 1 km) plus two-way light-time. Canonical ISL time transfer remains off.
_formation: crossTrackSpread 1.0 = fully 3-D. At 0 the projected-circular helix puts z=2x for every member, making the ISL LOS matrix exactly rank-2.
_perturbations: The realism overlay enables luni-solar and SRP terms in both the truth and estimator force families (R-3).
